name: codex-astra-jp-unescape-r1
final_message:
Created `tests/test_agent.py` using only pytest and the standard library. Library code is unchanged.

Ran the requested command: **93 passed, 1 xfailed**. The strict expected-failure test documents an existing bug: `~01` incorrectly decodes to `/` instead of `~1`.

xfail_lines: XFAIL tests/test_agent.py::test_escaped_tilde_followed_by_one_is_not_a_slash - unescape decodes ~0 before ~1, decoding ~01 twice
